qe: Who led the Bhumij revolt of 1832-33 in the Manbhum region, known in colonial records as 'Ganga Narayan ka Hungama'?
qh: 1832-33 के मानभूम क्षेत्र के भूमिज विद्रोह का नेतृत्व किसने किया, जिसे औपनिवेशिक अभिलेखों में 'गंगा नारायण का हंगामा' कहा जाता है?
e: Ganga Narayan Singh ne 1832-33 me Bhumij vidroh (jise angrej abhilekhon me 'Ganga Narayan ka Hungama' likha gaya) ka netritva kiya; yah Manbhum tatha Dhalbhum kshetra (aaj Jharkhand-Paschim Bengal seema) me chala, jo us samay Bihar prant ka hissa tha. Vidroh ka karan angrejon tatha unke thekedaron (diwano) dwara ki jaane wali kathor lagan-vasuli tatha shoshan tha; 2 July 1832 ko unhone Barabazar par kabza kiya tatha British munsif aadalaton tatha khazanon ko lutt liya. Vidroh ko dabane ke baad angrejon ne 1833 me Regulation XIII jaise kanoon banaye, jisse Chotanagpur kshetra me prashasanik tatha jamin sambandhi sudhar karne pade. Buddhu Bhagat Kol vidroh (1831-32), Tilka Manjhi Paharia vidroh (1780-85) tatha Bhukhan Singh Chero vidroh (1800-02) ke neta the - isliye woh sahi vikalp nahi. Exam point: Bhumij vidroh 1832-33 = Ganga Narayan Singh, 'Ganga Narayan ka Hungama', Manbhum kshetra; parinaam me 1833 ka Regulation XIII laaya gaya.

qe: Telanga Kharia, a tribal leader of the Gumla region, is remembered for founding which institution of self-governance?
qh: गुमला क्षेत्र के आदिवासी नेता तेलंगा खड़िया किस स्व-शासन संस्था की स्थापना के लिए याद किए जाते हैं?
e: Telanga Kharia Gumla ke Sisai kshetra ke Murgu gaon se the tatha unhone 1850 se 1880 tak British shasan tatha zamindaron ke khilaf aadivasi pratirodh ka netritva kiya. Unka sabse mahatvapurn sansthagat kaam 'Jodiya Panchayat' ki sthapna thi; 'jodiya' ka arth hai jodi ya saajhedari, yaani is panchayat me gaon ke badon ko nyayik, prashasanik tatha suraksha ke adhikar diye gaye, jisse aadivasi samaj apne faisle khud kar sakta tha tatha british aadalaton par nirbharta kam ho gayi. Unhone lagbhag 13 jodiya panchayaton ka network khada kiya maana jaata hai tatha British nyay-vyavastha ka virodh kiya tatha apne logon ko unki adalat me jaane se roka. Aakhir me 23 April 1880 ko Sisai ke ek training camp me unki shahadat ho gayi; aaj unka samadhi-sthal 'Telanga Toppa Tand' state-protected dharohar hai. Santhal Pargana angrejon ne banaya, Vaishali ki gana sabha prachin Magadha ka ganarajya thi tatha Tana Bhagat Andolan Jatra Bhagat se juda hai - isliye sahi uttar Jodiya Panchayat hai. Exam point: Telanga Kharia = Jodiya Panchayat system ke sansthapak (Gumla-Simdega-Ranchi kshetra), 1850-1880 ka Kharia pratirodh, 23 April 1880 ko Sisai me shahadat.

qe: Bhukhan Singh is remembered as the leader of which uprising in the Palamu region (undivided Bihar) in 1800-1802?
qh: भूखन सिंह अविभाजित बिहार के पलामू क्षेत्र में 1800-1802 के किस विद्रोह के नेता के रूप में याद किए जाते हैं?
e: Bhukhan Singh Palamu kshetra (aaj Jharkhand, tab undivided Bihar) ke Chero kisano ke neta the; 1800 se 1802 ke beech unhone angrej zamin-bandobast tatha thekedaron dwara jameen ki nilami ke khilaf bada vidroh chalaya. Chero log Palamu ke pahadi-jangal kshetra me apne pahadi ilaake me rahte the; angrejon ne wahan naya lagan tatha jameen ka record lagu kiya, jisse unki zameen cheen kar nilam karne ki ghatnayein badhi. Bhukhan Singh ne pahadi kshetra me morche banakar pratirodh kiya tatha kai jagah angrej adhikariyon ko khatam kar diya; vidroh ko dabane ke liye British ko bhaari sena bhejni padi. Isi kshetra me 1857 me Nilambar tatha Pitambar jaise Bhogta netaon ne bhi vidroh ka netritva kiya. Santhal Hul 1855-56 me Sidhu-Kanhu ne, Kol vidroh 1831-32 me Buddhu Bhagat ne tatha Bhumij vidroh 1832-33 me Ganga Narayan Singh ne chalaun - isliye sahi uttar Chero kisan vidroh hai. Exam point: Bhukhan Singh = Chero kisan vidroh (Palamu, 1800-1802) ke neta, angreji jamin-bandobast tatha nilami ke viruddh; 1857 me Palamu me Nilambar-Pitambar (Bhogta) ne bhi bhaag liya.

qe: The 1940 session of the Indian National Congress, held in a place that is today in Jharkhand but was then part of Bihar, was convened at:
qh: भारतीय राष्ट्रीय कांग्रेस का 1940 का अधिवेशन, जो आज झारखंड में है पर उस समय बिहार का हिस्सा था, कहाँ आयोजित हुआ था?
e: 1940 ka Congress adhiveshan Ramgarh me hua tha; Ramgarh us samay Bihar prant me tha tatha aaj yah kshetra Jharkhand me aata hai. Is adhiveshan ki adhyakshta Maulana Abul Kalam Azad ne ki tatha yah adhiveshan apne samay ke rajnitik faislon ke liye mahatvapurn raha; usi daur me angrej sarkar ne bharat ko dusre vishwa-yuddh me shaamil hone ke liye samarthan dene ka dabaav banaya tha. Congress ne is adhiveshan me saaf taur par kaha ki bharat ki janta ki marzi ke bina yuddh me sahyog nahi diya ja sakta, jab tak desh ko swaraj nahi diya jaata; isi stithi ne aage 1942 ke 'Bharat Chhodo' aandolan ki neev taiyar ki. Patna tatha Gaya me Congress ke anya karyakram tatha sammelan hote rahe Muzaffarpur kshetra kisan aandolan tatha anya karyakramon se juda raha, lekin 1940 ka adhiveshan Ramgarh me hua. Exam point: 1940 ka Congress adhiveshan = Ramgarh (tab Bihar, aaj Jharkhand), adhyakshta Maulana Abul Kalam Azad; yahan se 'yuddh me sahyog tab hi jab swaraj mile' ka rukh taya hua.

qe: In the 1857 revolt, which cantonment of Bihar saw the sepoys mutiny and march to Arrah to join Kunwar Singh?
qh: 1857 के विद्रोह में बिहार के किस छावनी में सैनिकों ने विद्रोह करके कुंवर सिंह से मिलने के लिए आरा की ओर कूच किया?
e: 1857 ke vidroh me Dinapur (aaj Danapur, Patna ke paas) ki chhavni ke sepoy garrison ne vidroh kiya tatha Arrah ki taraf kuch kiya; wahan pahunch kar unhone Jagdishpur ke Veer Kunwar Singh ko apna 'supreme commander' ghoshit kiya. Isi sanyukt shakti ne Arrah ke khazane tatha prashasanik vyavastha par kabza kiya tatha angrejon ke khilaf morche banaye; Bibiganj, Atraulia tatha Azamgarh ke maidan-e-jung me angrejon ko kadak chunauti mili. Dinapur ki chhavni bharat ki sabse purani military chhavniyon me ginti hai, isliye wahan ke sepoys ka vidroh poore Bihar me aag ki tarah faila. Munger me Mir Qasim ka kila tha (1760 ke dashak ka), Barh tatha Bhagalpur me aise vidroh ka kendra nahi raha - isliye sahi uttar Dinapur (Danapur) hai. Exam point: 1857 me Bihar me vidroh ka pramukh military kendra = Dinapur (Danapur) chhavni; wahan ke sepoys Arrah pahunch kar Veer Kunwar Singh ko supreme commander banaya; 23 April 1858 ki Jagdishpur vijay Vijayotsav ke roop me manayi jaati hai.

qe: The Salt Satyagraha of 1930 in Bihar was led at Garhpura in Begusarai district by which leader?
qh: 1930 का बिहार में नमक सत्याग्रह बेगूसराय जिले के गरहपुरा में किस नेता के नेतृत्व में हुआ था?
e: 1930 ke Namak Satyagraha (civil disobedience) ke dauran Dr. Sri Krishna Singh, jinhe 'Bihar Kesari' kaha jaata hai, Begusarai jile ke Garhpura me namak kanoon toda tatha unhone khud vidroh ka netritva kiya; police ki lathi bhi unhe rok nahi saki. Unka janm nanihal Garhpura se juda tha tatha woh Begusarai kshetra ke gaon-gaon me jaakar logon ko angreji namak ka virodh karne ke liye prerit karte the. Aage woh Bihar ke pehle Premier (1937) tatha azaadi ke baad pehle Mukhyamantri (1946-1961) bane; unke samay me 1950 ka Bihar Bhumi Sudhar Kanoon aaya jisse zamindari khatm hui. Dr. Rajendra Prasad Champaran tatha samvidhan sabha ke kaam se, Swami Sahajanand kisan aandolan se tatha Maulana Mazharul Haque Home Rule tatha Sadaqat Ashram se jude the - isliye Garhpura ke namak satyagraha ke liye Dr. Sri Krishna Singh hi sahi uttar hain. Exam point: 1930 ke Namak Satyagraha me Garhpura (Begusarai) ka netritva = Dr. Sri Krishna Singh ('Bihar Kesari'); woh Bihar ke pehle Premier tatha pehle Mukhyamantri the; unke samay me Bihar Bhumi Sudhar Kanoon 1950 aaya.

qe: Bihar Vidyapeeth, set up in 1921 for national education during the freedom movement, was founded with the efforts of which leader?
qh: स्वतंत्रता आंदोलन के दौरान राष्ट्रीय शिक्षा के लिए 1921 में स्थापित बिहार विद्यापीठ किस नेता के प्रयासों से स्थापित हुआ?
e: 1921 me Patna ke Sadaqat Ashram kshetra me 'Bihar Vidyapeeth' ki sthapna hui; iska mukhya uddeshya yah tha ki angreji sarkar ke school-college chhodne wale vidyarthiyon ke liye 'rashtriya shiksha' ka vaikalpik system banaya jaye. Iske pramukh sansthapak tatha sanrakshak Dr. Rajendra Prasad the, jinhone aage samvidhan sabha ki adhyakshta tatha rashtrapati ke roop me desh ki seva ki; unhe 'Deshratna' kaha jaata hai. Azaadi ke andolan me jab 'asahyog' ke dauran vidyarthiyon ne sarkari sansthan chhode, tab Vidyapeeth ne unhe hindi, itihas, sanskrit tatha anya vishyon ki padhai di tatha deshbhakti ka paath padhaya. Isi tarah Bihar me Kisan Sabha tatha anya rashtriya sansthaon ne bhi aise kaam kiye. Dr. Sri Krishna Singh mukhyamantri bane, JP ne 1974 ka aandolan chalaun tatha Bindeshwari Dubey bhi mukhyamantri rahe - lekin Bihar Vidyapeeth ka naam Rajendra Babu se sabse zyada juda hai. Exam point: Bihar Vidyapeeth = 1921, Patna (Sadaqat Ashram kshetra), rashtriya shiksha ke liye; pramukh shrey Dr. Rajendra Prasad ('Deshratna') ko, jo samvidhan sabha ke adhyaksh tatha bharat ke pehle Rashtrapati bane.

qe: Mahendra Misir, known as 'Purvi ke Janak', is remembered in the freedom movement for which unusual activity?
qh: 'पूर्वी के जनक' कहे जाने वाले महेंद्र मिसिर स्वतंत्रता आंदोलन में किस अनोखी गतिविधि के लिए याद किए जाते हैं?
oe: Setting up the first Hindi newspaper of Bihar
Writing patriotic songs for the Indian National Army
Printing counterfeit British currency to fund revolutionary activities
Leading a peasant march to Nepal
oh: बिहार के पहले हिंदी समाचार-पत्र की स्थापना
इंडियन नेशनल आर्मी के लिए देशभक्ति गीत लिखना
क्रांतिकारी गतिविधियों के खर्च के लिए अंग्रेजी करेंसी की नकली नोट छापना
नेपाल तक किसान मार्च का नेतृत्व
e: Mahendra Misir ko 'Purvi ke Janak' yaani 'Purvi' lok-gayan shaili ka janm-data kaha jaata hai; woh lok-kavi tatha krantikari dono the. Unke baare me sabse charchit baat yah hai ki unhone angreji sarkar ke khilaf harkat me kharch ke liye nakli (counterfeit) currency tatha stamp chhapne ka kaam kiya; is gair-kanooni kaam ki wajah se unhe sarkar ke nishane par liya gaya tatha jail bhi jaana pada. Lok-kavi hone ke naate unki rachnayein gaon-gaon me suni jaati thi tatha unke geeton me samrajyavad ke khilaf gussa tatha kisanon ki peer dikhti thi; isi tarah ke kavi aandolan ka sanskritik aadhaar banate the. Indian National Army ke geet Subhas Chandra Bose ke aandolan se jude log likhte the, kisan march tatha 'Bihar Bandhu' (bihar ka pehla hindi akhbaar, 1872) Babu Ramkrishna Varma se juda hai - isliye sahi uttar nakli currency chhapna hai. Exam point: Mahendra Misir = 'Purvi ke Janak', lok-kavi tatha krantikari; angreji currency ke nakli not chhapakar aandolan ko paisa pahunchaya; Bihari Hindi patrakarita Babu Ramkrishna Varma ke 'Bihar Bandhu' (1872) se judi hai.
